# Tables and Figures

<!-- ============================================================================
     STUB. Layout mirrors studies/land_tenure/narrative/sections/98_tables_and_figures.Rmd
     and studies/ag_services'. NO EXHIBIT IS LISTED HERE because this study has no
     manuscript, and the exhibit list is a manuscript decision - ag_services could
     write its 98 from a v000 draft's exhibit list, and there is no equivalent here.

     Writing speculative ft_table1()/ft_table2() calls would invent the paper's
     structure and then hide that invention behind builders that error. So this
     file carries the mechanics and nothing else.

     THE MECHANICS, recorded so they are not relearned:
     * Tables are built by ../scripts/exhibit_helpers_tables.R (no ft_*() builders
       yet - see its header). Figures come from ../scripts/101_exhibit_figures.R
       into output/figures/.
     * Exhibit titles are markdown headings, NOT flextable captions, so they appear
       in the Word navigation pane.
     * Landscape exhibits are grouped into ONE section. Emitting sec_landscape()
       then sec_portrait() back to back creates an empty portrait section, which
       Word renders as a blank page. A section's properties apply to the content
       BEFORE it: sec_portrait() closes a portrait run, sec_landscape() closes a
       landscape run.
     * Every number printed here must come from the pipeline. Nothing gets pasted
       in from a spreadsheet.

     WHAT 101 WILL PRODUCE once 004 has run, i.e. the candidate figure list:
       heterogeneity_crop_region.png, heterogeneity_genderAge.png, plus the
       robustness, matching-TE, covariate-balance and distribution figures the
       fig_*() builders write. Their .csv companions land in output/figures/.
     ============================================================================ -->
